features.text: AIR COMPRESSION SUPPORT: Medial and lateral bladders provide adjustable pneumatic compression for targeted relief.
TOOL FREE PRESSURE CONTROL: Built in pump and release allow quick adjustments throughout the day.
MOISTURE MANAGING LINER: Airmesh interior helps reduce heat buildup for better comfort.
NATURAL GAIT ROCKER: Dual axis sole promotes smoother steps while tissues heal.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L4361, L4360: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
